name: loom-design
description: The loom family's design side: discovery (what users need, is it worth building) → product principles → interface design → spec, plus the deterministic pipeline conductor.

interface.shortDescription: Discovery → principles → interface design → spec, the loom family's design side
interface.longDescription: loom-design is the design-side plugin of the loom suite. One entry router (using-loom-design) routes to four stations: discovery (user-insights maps evidence-linked needs; business-value renders an adversarial worth-it verdict), product-principles (a PRINCIPLES.md constitution — north star + falsifiable principles), interface-design (design-system emits DESIGN.md tokens, interaction-flows emits ui-flows.md, design-critic hunts surface omissions), and spec (spec-expansion fans a seed into a high-recall spec draft, completeness-critic adversarially hunts omissions). It also ships using-loom-pipeline, the deterministic conductor that drives the four Workflow-driven stations end-to-end — NOTE: the conductor requires the Claude Code Workflow primitive and is N/A on Codex hosts, where the stations run interactively instead.
defaultPrompt: What do users actually need here?
Draft the product principles for this idea.
Design the UI/UX for this feature.
